groundContrastPolicy.measurement: Rec.601 RGB luminance on a 0–255 scale; overlays keep their existing contrast.
groundContrastPolicy.rule: No terrain base is darkened. Forest, wetland, cave and tar character comes from hue, desaturation and texture on a light base. Objects provide the darker forms.
groundContrastPolicy.desaturation: Each terrain proposal has RGB channel spread no greater than its current base; cool/olive hue preserves biome identity.
groundContrastPolicy.objectGuidance: Ground is the light, desaturated canvas. Do not blanket-desaturate or lighten interactable sprites: preserve their dark outlines, shadow planes and lit tops. Original trunk.png closed frame 0 is the contrast benchmark.
